gallery.filename: Linear B tablet from Nestor's Palace resized white balanced white bg.png
gallery.title: File:Linear B tablet from Nestor's Palace resized white balanced white bg.png
gallery.description:
Clay tablet inscribed with Linear B script, from the Mycenaean palace of Pylos, ca. 1450 BCE. Located in the Archaeological Museum at Chora near Pylos, this tablet is a copy of the original likely located at NAMA Athens.
The original photo was taken by user:Fæ own work 18 September 2010

This version of the image has been resized for deeper dpi, cropped slightly, white balanced, and the background has been changed to solid white.
